entities.name: Combined Tracking Area Updating Procedure

entities.name: Combined Detach Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UEs operating in CS/PS mode 1 or 2 to detach for non-EPS services.

entities.name: Attached for both EPS and non-EPS services
entities.description: UE state where it is attached to both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: Attached for non-EPS services only
entities.description: UE state where it is attached only to non-EPS services.

relations.description: UEs in CS/PS mode 1 or 2 shall use combined EPS/IMSI attach procedure.
UEs in CS/PS mode 1 or 2 already attached to both services shall use combined tracking area updating.
UEs in CS/PS mode 1 or 2 already attached to both services shall use combined detach procedure.
When T3242 is running and UE moves to E-UTRAN in eCall only mode, start T3444 with remaining time.
When T3242 is running and UE moves to E-UTRAN in eCall only mode, stop T3242.
When T3243 is running and UE moves to E-UTRAN in eCall only mode, start T3445 with remaining time.
When T3243 is running and UE moves to E-UTRAN in eCall only mode, stop T3243.
If UE is attached for both EPS and non-EPS services and T3242/T3243 running, perform combined TA updating.
If UE is attached for non-EPS services only and T3242/T3243 running, perform combined attach procedure.
